To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have been able to derive the canonical brackets amongst the basic fields of an interacting Higgs-Klein-Gordon theory (and its corresponding Hodge theory) by exploiting the spin-statistics and normal ordering theorems.

the basic canonical brackets of the creation and annihilations operators for a two dimensional gauge field theory are obtained by exploiting the spin-statistics and the normal ordering theorems and the concept of generators of infinitesimal symmetries.

the basic canonical brackets of the creation and annhilation operators for the two (1 +1)-dimensional interacting Hodge theory can be derived without using the definition of the canonically conjugate momentum corresponding to the basic fields.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the basic canonical brackets for the interacting Hodge theory in 2D.
the quantization of a Hodge theoretic model that is based on an interacting two-dimensional gauge field theory.
the canonical quantization of the interacting gauge field theoretic models that are physical realizations of Hodge theory.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our approach to quantization is a generalization of the canonical method of the quantization of the Hodge theory.
our present approach is a new and alternative way to the canonical quantization of the Hodge theory.
we have provided a physical interpretation of the Hodge theory in terms of a two-dimensional interacting gauge field theoretic system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been successful in quantizing the Hodge theory in a non-canonical way, i.e., without using the definition of the basic canonical conjugate momentums.

the canonical brackets of our present interacting Hodge theory are obtained in a manner similar to the case of the canonical brackets for the non-interacting free Hodge theory (i.e. the case where the U(1) coupling constant is set to zero) that was derived in our earlier paper (see [1]).

our model is an interacting gauge field theoretic realization of Hodge theory and that the basic canonical brackets of the theory can be derived without using the definition of the corresponding canonical conjugate momentas.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the concept of the canonical conjugates of a physical field is not the only way to define the canonical brackets for a gauge field theoretic theory that is a model for the Hodge theory.
our present approach can be extended to the quantization of the interacting Hodge theory in any number of dimensions (D) and for any number of U(N) gauge fields (N).

the basic canonical brackets of the theory (in the absence of any gauge fixing) can be obtained from the knowledge of the infinitesimal generators of the continuous symmetrization of the underlying theory.
